events.title: The free demo now has a fourth case
events.summary: It's 1998, and the record is wrong. You asked for more cases, and the free demo now holds a fourth. It plays differently from the first three. The Halvorsen Case A county weekly is preparing five pages on a fifteen-year-old murder conviction, and its editor has one rule: every line must stand on a document. events.title: The demo is out now
events.summary: It's 1998, and the record is wrong. You're the researcher who sets it straight. The free demo is live on Windows and macOS. It includes a guided warm-up and two full cases: The Glass Garden - a Cleveland reissue label needs the true credits of a 1970s Buffalo prog band whose sleeves are full of pseudonyms and misprints.
